mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the air sacs and capillaries was most worthwhile: it showed oxygen and carbon dioxide crossing in opposite directions without air mixing with blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the branching airways felt the least interesting because the connection was predictable, though the air arrow made it clear.
